ATTRIBUTION_GAP: ActualParticularStageControls.raw_jets hypothesis H : UniformWaveClass … (currentSource x j). ParticularCopyBounds.uniform_coefficients_jets (ParticularCopyBounds.lean:492) takes any source with UniformLocalJets bounds plus a UniformModalControl. ActualParticularControl.referenceControl (ActualParticularControl.lean:609) builds that control for any f in the class and any j ≠ 0, given a PhaseConstruction.

I read p.80 myself and checked the cited declarations in source. All 24 names exist in decls.jsonl. raw_jets quantifies ∀ x ∀ j≠0 over the fixed controlPatch, with bounds of the form ∀ m ∃ C ∃ p. Label B N0 is fixed by (choice B N0).prepared.N. Prepared.large is required once, for all n ≥ N. nextCoefficients keeps the labels and doubles residualBand, and selected_energy is uniform in j≠0. Both skeptics independently upheld both findings, and no new findings were raised. I added the skeptics' better declarations: common_bounds, finite_harmonic_uniform, controlPatch, uniform_coefficients_jets and referenceControl. The auditor's 'mildly stronger' remark is not a strengthening: per-j bounds with constants chosen after j are equivalent to the finite-M form, by taking a maximum over the finitely many harmonics. 'Full pulse interval' and the Ioo/Icc distinction belong to Prop 7.2.

findings.summary: No declaration states Corollary 7.3 as such. The uniformity in stage, harmonic set and derivative order is encoded structurally. The domain (Label B N0, slowStrip, controlPatch) is fixed first, and constants and degrees come afterwards via quantifier order (∀ x ∀ j≠0 ∀ m ∃ C ∃ p).

raw_jets and common_bounds apply the inverse to the literal residual currentSource x j of an arbitrary cycle state, not to an arbitrary prescribed source f_m. The general prescribed-source form exists in uniform_coefficients_jets together with referenceControl.
